descriptions.zh:
我们用于压制灵能的§H远古堡场§!正在发出异常的读数。这通常是来自[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的灵能活动激增的结果，但我们并没有找到任何这种堕落行为的迹象。

那么答案也许就藏在我们的国境内。长距离遥感影像显示§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与远古堡场发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。
descriptions.en:
Our psi-suppressive §HAncient Ward§! is producing irregular readings. This would normally result from spikes in psionic activity on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but we have found no evidence of such depravity.

The answer may lie beyond our borders. Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, which correlates with the erratic measurements of the Ancient Ward.

descriptions.zh:
新探索到的§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。[root.GetName]的船员遭受到了一系列精神症状：情绪波动；令人衰弱的精神压力；反复出现难以形容的恐怖景象。他们的舰队系统也发生了怪异的故障。

这些现象与我们祖先记录的体验非常相符；非常有可能就是他们所说的“灵能辐射”，一种极具破坏力的能量发射形式。在§H远古堡场§!的保护不到的§H[owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!上，我们第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。

在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系。在更彻底评估其影响之前，我们强烈反对派遣任何舰船深入。
descriptions.en:
An alarming situation is developing in the newly explored §H[from.GetName]§! system. The crew of the [root.GetName] is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror. Their fleet's systems are also experiencing strange, erratic malfunctions.

These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission. Outside of the protection of the §HAncient Ward§! on §H[owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!, we are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered the source of these dangerous emissions to be the nearby §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system. Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.

descriptions.zh:
[root.GetName]的船员们岌岌可危。

在§H[from.GetName]§!恒星系里暴露到这种极高等级的灵能辐射后，他们开始产生比此前报道的更糟糕的精神压力。舰队的系统也受到严重故障的困扰，妨碍了多数正常的功能。

长程扫描表明有更高等级的辐射在从§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系中释放出来。在更彻底评估其影响之前，我们强烈反对派遣任何舰船深入。
descriptions.en:
The crew of the [root.GetName] is in danger.

Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the §H[from.GetName]§! system, they began experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.

Long-range scanners indicate even higher levels of radiation in the nearby §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system. Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.

tooltips.zh: 准备开始§Y第一次接触§!流程。
tooltips.en: Prepare to initiate the §YFirst Contact§! process.

descriptions.zh:
出乎意料的是，§H[This.System.GetName]§!恒星系中存在许多似乎是由智慧生物所建造的大型物体。我们为了了解其创造者，将其代称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!，并尝试在保持安全距离的前提下进行直接的沟通工作。

该恒星系内所有的生命形式必然都处在我们探测到的高水平灵能辐射的威胁下。
descriptions.en:
Astonishingly, the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system appears to contain a number of large objects that appear to be of intelligent construction. We might learn more about their creators, code-named §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, by attempting direct communications from a safe distance.

Any life forms in the system must be in great danger from the high levels of psi-radiation we detected.

descriptions.zh:
进一步的研究确定在§H[This.System.GetName]§!恒星系中的物体是一艘外星飞船，但我们还未与任何船上人员建立任何沟通渠道。

特使[exiled_envoy.GetName]汇报[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的团队开始遭受到超心灵学症状的困扰，包括[This.System.GetName]上出现奇特生物的无法解释的幻象。尽管有这些问题，我们的特使还是坚持投入[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的这项任务。
descriptions.en:
Further study has confirmed the objects in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system to be alien spacecraft, though we have yet to make contact with any of the vessel's occupants.

Troublingly, envoy [exiled_envoy.GetName] reports that [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team has begun suffering from parapsychological symptoms, including unexplained visions of strange beings present in [This.System.GetName]. Despite these concerns, our envoy remains steadfast in [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] dedication to the mission.

descriptions.zh:
在数个月的寂静后，我们收到了一份来自[exiled_envoy.GetName]的通讯。这位通常冷静而直率的特使发来了一份离奇而混乱的报告。[exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap]杂乱无章地描述了一些奇怪的意象——显然是纠缠在一起的梦境和幻觉。[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]团队的所有人也都一样神志不清。

目前他们已经解除了职务，该任务也无限期搁置了。无论§H[This.System.GetName]§!里的到底是什么东西，目前我们都暂时没有办法安全地调查。
descriptions.en:
After months of silence, we received a transmission from [exiled_envoy.GetName]. Usually sober and direct, the envoy gave a bizarre, muddled report. [exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap] submitted rambling descriptions of strange imagery - apparently a tangle of dreams and delusions. No member of [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team proved to be any more coherent.

They have been relieved of their duties, and this mission has been suspended indefinitely. Whatever presence is in §H[This.System.GetName]§!, it is currently beyond our means to safely investigate.

descriptions.zh:
悬浮在翻滚的水流之上。是§H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!，还是……？

§H……呼叫……§!

水面扭转着分开。恶臭的瘴气从无底的深处喷涌而出。

§H……回复……没有……§!

无休无止。令人窒息。

这太糟糕了。
descriptions.en:
Suspended above the roiling current. §H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!, or...?

§H...calling...§!

The surface twists open. A fetid miasma belches from unseen depths.

§H...answer...nothing...§!

Ceaseless. Suffocating.

It is terrible.

Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.

descriptions.zh:
近处的灵能“感染”已经传播进了§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系中。

尽管有§H远古堡场§!提供保护，这种侵蚀导致我们在§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上的人口也开始表现出可能与灵能辐射荼毒有关的一些症状了。预测显示，这种心灵瘟疫可能很快会传播至§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!，我们的母星也会因此受到进一步的威胁。

尽管有风险，但是我们想彻底地学会如何保护自己，最好的办法就是接近现象的源头进行研究。
descriptions.en:
The nearby psionic 'infection' has spread into the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system.

Despite the protections offered by the §HAncient Ward§!, this encroachment has caused our population on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! to experience mild symptoms suggestive of psi-radiation poisoning. Projections show that the mind-plague may soon expand into §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!, where it will pose an even greater danger to our homeworld.

Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.

label.zh: 让我们学会怎么阻止这种感染吧。
label.en: Let us learn to stop this infection.

descriptions.zh:
我们的研究者们在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系内的剧毒灵能辐射中备受煎熬，但他们的任务带来的重要的发现。

我们将这种危险的现象归类为§H“灵能光环”§!，这是一种巨大破坏性能量的积聚体，它不仅会扰乱我们的思想，也能干扰我们的技术装备。它是从§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系传播而出，那里的灵能能量增长到能够跨越恒星系进行传播的强度了。

它已经沾染了§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!恒星系，造成了毁灭性的影响。§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上的§H远古堡场§!只能提供有限的保护。
descriptions.en:
Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, but their mission led to important findings.

We have classified this alarming phenomenon as a §H'Psionic Aura'§!, a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

It has already reached the §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system, where the effects have been devastating. The §HAncient Ward§! on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! only offers limited protection.

descriptions.zh:
我们的研究者们在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系内的剧毒灵能辐射中备受煎熬，但他们的任务带来的重要的发现。

descriptions.en:
Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system, but their mission led to important findings.

We have classified this alarming phenomenon as a §H'Psionic Aura'§!, a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

If it reaches our §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system, the effects would be devastating. The §HAncient Ward§! on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! only offers limited protection.

label.zh: 我们必须增强远古堡场。
label.en: We must strengthen the Ancient Ward.

descriptions.zh:
我们孜孜不倦的研究者们开发出了一种增强§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上§H远古堡场§!的方法。通过改进灵能衰减器，它的防护效果不仅可以覆盖到整颗行星，还能保护§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!系。

这项研究激发了在该失落的科技领域内更广泛的研究。我们现在知道灵能辐射和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]意识之间存在着相互联系：不止是这种能量发射可以影响我们的精神状态，我们的精神状态也同样能影响灵能辐射等级。看来我们对“灵能”实践的古老禁忌是有科学依据的。
descriptions.en:
Our tireless researchers have developed a method for strengthening the §HAncient Ward§! on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. By enhancing its psionic attenuators, the protection can be extended to cover not only the whole planet, but the entire §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system.

This research has stimulated broader study into this lost technology. We now know that the link between psi-radiation and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind is reciprocal: not only can these emissions affect our mental states, but our mental states can influence psi-radiation levels. It would seem that our immemorial taboo against 'psionic' practices has a scientific basis after all.

tooltips.en: Begins the Event Chain: §YThe Grand Ward§!

descriptions.zh: 我们的§H宏伟堡场§!建好之后，§H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§!星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!上，大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
descriptions.en: With our §HGrand Ward§! now complete, psi-radiation in the §H[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]§! system has been reduced to manageable levels. The population of §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们§H宏伟堡场§!的完工，§H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§!星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
descriptions.en: With our §HGrand Ward§! now complete, psi-radiation on §H[Root.GetHomeWorldName]§! has been reduced to manageable levels. The population is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

descriptions.zh: 无论如何，这个§H灵能光环§!以及可能存在着的其他同类都依旧在荼毒着这个恒星系。我们的科学家认为，宏伟堡场的科技可以用于开发更强大的§H“虚境封印”§!。这些硕大无比的装置可以抑制一整个星团的光环。在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系建造一个虚境封印将能大幅度提升控制灵能威胁的能力。
descriptions.en: Nevertheless, this §HPsionic Aura§!, and potentially others, still poisons the wider galaxy. Our scientists hypothesize that the technology of the Grand Ward could be applied to the development of a more powerful §H'Shroud Seal'§!. These massive structures should be able to suppress Auras in entire star clusters. Building a Shroud Seal in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system will be a significant advancement in controlling the psionic menace.

label.en: This is research worthy of pursuit.

descriptions.en: We have lost control of our homeworld, §H[root.GetHomeWorldName]§!. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家们完成了对先进§H灵能压制§!科技的研发。现在可以在我们控制的任何一个殖民地内建造灵能抑制器来复现宏伟堡场的效果了。

然而，要在其他恒星系内控制§H灵能光环§!的传播，我们还需要建造一种被称为§H虚境封印§!的更加强大的装置。这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解灵能光环，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。

这项研究也证实了一个令人不安的理论：存在着一个被称为§H“虚境”§!的空灵领域！古代神秘文献中描述的那种灵能维度很有可能是真的。该理论认为，感性众生的认知活动可以使能量从虚境内传递到可观察现实中——这种过程就是灵能光环的一般性来源。

这意味着我们不仅仅只是在与宇宙的客观力量作斗争，而是与某种潜在的未知意图的可疑行为对抗。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists have completed the development of advanced §HPsionic Suppression§! technology. We can now replicate the effects of the Grand Ward on any colony under our control by building a Psionic Suppressor.

However, to control the spread of §HPsionic Auras§! in other systems, we will need to construct a more powerful device known as a §HShroud Seal§!. These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

This research has also given credence to a disturbing theory: an ethereal realm known as the §H'Shroud'§!, a dimension of psionic energy described in occult texts of old, appears to truly exist. The theory posits that the cognitive activity of sentient beings can cause energy to pass from the Shroud into observable reality - and this process is the root cause of Psionic Auras in general.

This means that we are not merely contending with objective forces of the universe, but potentially calculated actions of unknown intent.

label.en: So the §H'Shroud'§! is real after all...?

titles.zh: 灵主乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特

descriptions.zh:
§H屏幕上的人物以一种稳定、催眠的节奏与人交流，不时会作很长时间的停顿。§!

遥远的邻居们，鉴于你们对直接接触不予回应，我们只好诉诸于粗糙的技术通信。

我是§H乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特§!，§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的灵主。事态很紧急；原谅我的仓促。你们在§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!恒星系的装置正在影响我们光环的流动。我们暂且认为这种不可接受的局面只是你方的无心之过。

这种光环利人利己，应当照耀整个星系。为了证明你们对上上善道的承诺，我们要求你们立即拆除所谓的“虚境封印”。
descriptions.en:
§HThe figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.§!

Far neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.

I am §HUk-Hogolath Scarat§!, Psiarch of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities. Your device in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system is inhibiting the spread of our auric flow. We assume this intolerable situation is the result of an ignorant mistake on your part.

The aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called 'Shroud Seal'.

label.zh: 我们之前可没收到过什么通讯。
label.en: We received no prior communication from you.

descriptions.zh: 我们用真音和你们沟通。你们听到了，你们肯定能听到内心的传音。你们有这种天赋的，但你们选择了压制。
descriptions.en: We spoke with the true voice. Had you listened, you would have heard the call within. You have the gift, though you choose to suppress it.

label.zh: 这光环具有破坏性，是一种瘟疫。
label.en: The aura is destructive. A plague.

descriptions.zh: 你的理解有问题。光环是我们守护神赐予的神圣礼物。它能打倒一切带来毁灭之物。
descriptions.en: Your understanding is faulty. The aura is a sacred gift of our protector. It casts down that which seeks to destroy.

label.zh: 如果我们拒绝你们的要求呢？
label.en: What if we refuse your demands?

descriptions.zh: 损害光环者无论是谁，都要镇压。如果你们拒绝，我们就要被迫采取军事行动了。
descriptions.en: Whoever harms the aura must be subdued. If you refuse, we will be forced to take military action.

label.zh: 我们绝不会摧毁自己的遗产。
label.en: We will never destroy our heritage.
We agree to dismantle the Seal.

descriptions.zh: 愚昧的蠢货。
descriptions.en: Benighted fools.

options.script: name = END_TRANSMISSION

descriptions.zh: 明智的决定。
descriptions.en: A wise decision.

descriptions.zh:
为了避免与§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!发生直接冲突，我们默认了他们对拆解§H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§!系内虚境封印的要求。

与那些散布灵能瘟疫的家伙们的接触已经在§H[this.GetName]§!引起了严重关切。移除虚境封印似乎也只能是一种暂时的绥靖政策。他们很定还会想要对我们的§H宏伟堡场§!做一样的事情的——这就是我们绝对不能接受的事情。

无论如何，一战在所难免。
descriptions.en:
In order to avoid immediate conflict with the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!, we acquiesced to their demands to dismantle the Shroud Seal in the §H[exiled_system_border.GetName]§! system.

Exposure to those responsible for the psionic pestilence has caused grave concern throughout the §H[this.GetName]§!. Removal of the Shroud Seal is only likely to be a short term appeasement. They will eventually expect the same of our §HGrand Ward§! - and that is something we cannot accept.

In any case, future hostilities seem inevitable.

descriptions.zh:
§H灵主的图像一出现，便开始冷漠地、无声地指责。§!

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我很失望还要打这通通讯。尽管你们已经同意拆除了虚境封印，但我们知道你们还在§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!维持这一座与之功能相似的建筑。你们的意图路人皆知。你们用行为证明了自己有多无知。你们对我们的光环流横加阻挠，对整个灵能事业无端蔑视，这都与整个跨星系的和平水火不容。我们别无选择。

等着见我们的舰队吧。

§HAs soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.§!

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission. Though you agreed to dismantle the Shroud Seal, we are aware that you have maintained a building on §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! with similar capabilities. Your intent is clear. Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.

Be prepared to meet our fleets.

label.zh: 这话该说给你们自己听。闭嘴吧。

随着巨大的灵能衰减器闪耀着启动，我们的§H虚境封印§!开始逐渐将§H灵能光环§!驱赶出§H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§!恒星系。

跨星系扫描确认了帝国领土的其他部分都直接通过超空间航道连接到[exiled_center_system.GetName]。只需要一座虚境封印就能打消整个§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!境内的灵能光环。

我们胜利的关键就在于保护封印了。
descriptions.en:
With its colossal psionic attenuators flared into action, our §HShroud Seal§! is now in the process of driving out the §HPsionic Aura§! from the §H[exiled_center_system.GetName]§! system.

Interstellar scans have confirmed that the rest of our enemy's territory is directly connected to [exiled_center_system.GetName] via hyperlane. This single Shroud Seal is therefore capable of dissipating Psionic Auras throughout the entire territory of the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!.

Our victory hinges on the protection of the Seal.

descriptions.zh:
我们征服了§H[current_planet.GetName]§!上造成灵能威胁的殖民地。

我们了解到在该恒星系内出现的§H灵能光环§!受到了人口与§H虚境§!的心灵交互的增强。这些举措是由一群称为§H灵道会§!的精英灵能者们领导的。这个灵能邪教在宣导他们对所谓“超主”的忠诚，而这超主据称是虚境内一个强大实体，我们仅知道其被称为§H梦客§!。

他们的经文反复提到与这个存在有关的灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球§H[other_planet.GetName]§!上。找到这个东西就可以帮助我们阻止他们继续传播影响。
descriptions.en:
The colony of the psionic menace on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! has been conquered.

We have learned that the §HPsionic Aura§! present in this system was being amplified by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices are led by a group of elite telepaths, the §HAssembly of Mindways§!. This psionic cult promotes devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud, known only as §HThe Dreamer§!.

Their sacred texts make repeated mention of an artifact related to this being - apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Acquiring this object will aid us in preventing further spread of their influence.

options.script: name = shroud.6600.a

descriptions.zh:
我们完成了对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!的殖民，这曾是一颗[exiled_country.GetName]的行星。

从他们残留的记录中我了解到，该恒星系内此前存在的灵能光环是由人口和§H虚境§!的心灵互动造成的。带领这种行为的灵能邪教鼓吹诡异所谓的“超主”，据说是虚境里的一个叫做§H梦客§!的强大实体。

他们经文的残片中反复提到与这个存在有关的某件灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球§H[other_planet.GetName]§!上。要实现这个目标，就需要更慎重地征服[other_planet.GetName]，留下一部分人口。
descriptions.en:
We have completed our colonization of §H[current_planet.GetName]§!, a former world of the [exiled_country.GetName].

From the remains of their records, we have learned that the Psionic Aura previously present in this system was caused by the population's psychic interactions with the §HShroud§!. These practices were led by a psionic cult that promoted devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud known as §HThe Dreamer§!.

Fragments of their sacred texts refer to an artifact related to this being, apparently still extant on the planet §H[other_planet.GetName]§!. Securing this object would require a more measured conquest of [other_planet.GetName], leaving some of its population intact.

options.script: name = shroud.6601.a

descriptions.zh:
对§H[current_planet.GetName]§!的征服标志着我们对§H[exiled_country.GetName]§!的最终胜利。我们已立即对这些星球上的所有灵能活动进行了严厉打击，彻底消除了其可憎的§H灵能光环§!。

在该星球的主要城市里，矗立着一座名为§H梦客圣所§!的废弃高塔，它曾是前帝国现已声名狼藉的灵能邪教的至高神殿。我们的士兵形容它散发着一种神圣而令人不安的气息。

该建筑的最深处密室中，有一个密封严密的“茧”，散发出强大的局部灵能辐射。事实证明，标准弹药无法穿透其外部。要消除该物体对我们持续安全构成的潜在威胁，还需要进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
The conquest of §H[current_planet.GetName]§! marked our final victory against the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!. We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable §HPsionic Aura§!.

In the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the §HSanctum of the Dreamer§!, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.

The innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.

descriptions.en:
The eradication of the population on §H[current_planet.GetName]§! marked the end of the empire known as the §H[exiled_country.GetName]§!.

A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.

We may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its Psionic Aura, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.

descriptions.zh:
我们的研究者对§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上的“茧”进行了全面的分析。

对这座宏伟建筑的外部扫描显示，它是一个专门设计用于容纳强大灵能实体的高规格安全容器。尽管该容器有重合金绝缘层，但高水平的灵能辐射还是透过外壳渗漏了出来。

茧的周围安装有一组灵能衰减器；激活的时候时，周边地区的所有人都受到了严重的神经损伤。

茧的表面随之扭曲，从卵型变成了不断变化的螺旋形。其上的孔穴洞窟，我们接到了来自内部的直接通信……
descriptions.en:
Our researchers conducted a thorough analysis of the 'cocoon' on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!.

External scans of this imposing structure revealed it to be a highly secure receptacle designed to contain a powerful psionic entity. Despite the container's insulative layers of heavy alloys, high levels of psi-radiation are permeating through the enclosure nonetheless.

A group of psionic attenuators were installed around the cocoon; when activated, everyone in the vicinity was struck with searing levels of neural distress.

The surface of the cocoon then twisted, its ovoid form becoming a shifting helix. The aperture has opened, and we are receiving direct communication from within...

descriptions.zh: §H你听得到，但听不见。为什么？§!
descriptions.en: §HYou hear, but do not listen. Why?§!

label.zh: 我们不会让你荼毒我们的心智的！
label.en: We will not let you poison our minds!

descriptions.zh:
§H荼毒？不是毒……

这是一首歌。唱歌就要先听见。敞开心扉，共享美好吧。§!
descriptions.en:
§HPoison? Not poison...

A song. To sing, you must listen. Let go of your self, and share its beauty.§!

descriptions.zh:
§H轮回飞转……我们倾听。

星辰飞旋……我们歌唱。§!
descriptions.en:
§HAs the wheel spins... we listen.

As the stars spin... we sing.§!

descriptions.zh: §H转个不停。在上面，也在下面。是被叫做“虚境”的和声。§!
descriptions.en: §HEver-turning. Above and beneath. A harmony known as the 'Shroud'.§!

descriptions.zh: §H我在……做梦。梦见了一首歌。但歌声沉默了。合唱声去了哪里呢？§!
descriptions.en: §HI am... dreaming. Dreaming of a song. But the voices have gone silent. Where did the chorus go?§!

label.zh: 把你关在这里的人走了。
label.en: The ones who kept you here are gone.

descriptions.zh: §H你在这里。你会唱的……§!
descriptions.en: §HYou are here. You might sing...§!

descriptions.zh:
§H是醒与梦之间的细流……是此方与彼方之间的道路。

你听不见……你们的心智无法理解……§!
descriptions.en:
§HA flow between waking and dreaming... A path between here and there.

You cannot hear them - your minds lack the understanding...§!

descriptions.zh: §H我想听见歌声……但万籁俱寂……为什么？§!
descriptions.en: §HI want to hear singing... Everything is so quiet... Why?§!

label.en: What can you offer us in return?

descriptions.zh: §H可以让你们看看……我的梦。星球的诞生。§!
descriptions.en: §HI can show you... my dreams. The making of worlds.§!

label.en: How do we know we can trust you?

descriptions.zh:
§H你只需听着。这首歌是真理，只因它的美。这是一首美丽的真理。

但你的心关着。可以敞开的。§!
descriptions.en:
§HYou need only listen. The song is true because it is beautiful. A beautiful truth.

But your minds are closed. They can be opened.§!

descriptions.zh: §H我还在这……听着两个世界的歌。但这边的一首失声了。§!
descriptions.en: §HI am there still... I listen to the songs of two worlds. This one is muted.§!

descriptions.zh: §H你说的是真理。§!
descriptions.en: §HYou speak truth.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§!上发现的茧里寄宿着一个强大的异次元实体。它在某种意义上似乎就是威胁到我们心智健全的灵能光环的源头。

我们的灵能衰减器暂时减轻了它的危险，但目前还不清楚还能抑制它多久。如果能够妥善控制，我们甚至有可能利用它可怕的力量来实现自己的目的。

然而我们社会的多数人呼吁立即将其摧毁。这种东西光是存在就已经站在我们长久以来价值观的对立面上了。
descriptions.en:
The cocoon we discovered on §H[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]§! harbors a powerful interdimensional entity. It is likely that this being was somehow responsible for the Psionic Aura that threatened the sanctity of our minds.

Our psionic attenuators are mitigating the danger it poses for now, but it is unclear how long our devices can restrain its influence. It is possible that, under controlled circumstances, we can harness its terrible power for our own purposes.

Nevertheless, many in our society are calling for its immediate destruction. Its very existence stands against our long-held values.

label.zh: 想方设法利用这个……东西。
label.en: Find a way to make use of this... thing.

descriptions.zh:
思想穿透了灵能屏障。

我们听到了一段旋律，明亮但刺耳。

我们知道这种痛苦，强烈而熟悉。

§H你听见了。这梦是你的……唱吧，唱吧……§!
descriptions.en:
Thoughts penetrate our minds.

We hear a melody, bright and abrasive.

We know this pain, great and familiar.

§HYou listened. The dream is yours... Sing, sing...§!

descriptions.zh: §H我兑现了承诺。我为你们做了个梦。§!
descriptions.en: §HJust as I promised. I have dreamt for you.§!

descriptions.zh: §H星球。新的星球，在我和你之间。§!
descriptions.en: §HWorlds. New worlds, between mine and yours.§!

label.zh: 这些星球对我们有什么用？
label.en: What use are these worlds to us?

descriptions.zh: §H让我对它们歌唱吧。唱最明亮的歌。§!
descriptions.en: §HLet me sing to them. The brightest of songs.§!

tooltips.zh: 在我国境内最多可添加三颗§H虚境星球§!，每个星系最多一颗。
tooltips.en: Adds up to three §HShrouded Worlds§! within our borders, with a maximum of one per system.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经积累了大量关于§H虚境§!的知识，开发出了能抑制其恶劣影响的先进科技。在讨论如何将这种技术大规模应用到全星系的过程中，我们的舰队司令提出了一项有趣的提案。

他们建议将我们的一支舰队设立为一个独立的§H“灵督城邦”§!，这样就能向全星系的客户提供反灵能服务了。我们的前期投入将会用于建设一座空间站；而作为回报，我们可以获得其未来盈利的分红。他们的行动自由就能便于这类设施的大规模利用。

我们自然也能利用他们的服务——当然价格可以打折。
descriptions.en:
We have amassed great knowledge of the §HShroud§!, and developed advanced technologies to suppress its pernicious effects. While debating how to apply this mastery galaxy-wide, our fleet commanders have put forward an interesting proposal.

They suggest setting up one of our fleets as an independent §H'Mindwarden Enclave'§!, which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.

tooltips.zh: 现在可以将§Y30§!以上规模的舰队转化为§H灵督城邦§!。
tooltips.en: Any fleet of size §Y30§! or more can now be converted into a §HMindwarden Enclave§!.

descriptions.zh: §H[This.GetName]§!已经找到了一位适合创建我们第一个独立§H灵督城邦§!的候选者。如果审核通过，这支舰队将会在§H[This.Solar_System.GetName]§!设立一座新的设施，并立即开始提供反灵能服务。
descriptions.en: The §H[This.GetName]§! has been identified as a suitable candidate to form the basis of our first independent §HMindwarden Enclave§!. If authorized, the fleet would establish a new facility in §H[This.Solar_System.GetName]§! and begin providing anti-psionic services forthwith.

descriptions.zh:
我们正在考虑将§H[This.GetName]§!设立为一座独立的§H“灵督城邦”§!以向整个星系提供反灵能服务。我们的前期投入将会用于建设一座空间站；而作为回报，我们可以获得其未来盈利的分红。他们的行动自由就能便于这类设施的大规模利用。

我们自然也能利用他们的服务——当然价格可以打折。
descriptions.en:
We are considering setting up the §H[This.GetName]§! as an independent §H'Mindwarden Enclave'§!, which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.

options.script: name = shroud.6825.b

descriptions.zh:
与§H虚境§!以及灵能滥用的斗争让我们的人民变得更加强大，也更明确了我们的目标。第一座§H灵督城邦§!的建立正标志着一个康复和抵抗的新纪元。

在整个星系中，心智不再被灵能侵犯，所有星球都不再受到虚境力量的折磨。

这就是灵督时代。
descriptions.en:
Contending with the §HShroud§! and the irresponsible use of psionics has strengthened our people and clarified our goals into sharper focus. The foundation of the first §HMindwarden Enclave§! is the advent of a new age of healing and resistance.

Throughout the galaxy, no mind need be invaded by psionic aggressors, and no world tormented by forces from the Shroud.

It is now the age of the Mindwardens.

label.zh: 我们的旅程才刚刚开始

options.script: name = shroud.6830.a

descriptions.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们新近的合约有了丰硕的成果。我们扩展了自己的民用业务，现在有好几个公司雇佣我们，让我们提供安保和维和服务。在合约期间，我们的特工碰巧找到了一些有价值的科学研究。你会在定期分红的末尾找到这些附加的内容。
descriptions.en: Esteemed Patron, our recent contracts have been fruitful. We have expanded our civilian operations, and several corporations have hired us for a variety of security and peacekeeping services. While on contract, our operatives chanced upon some valuable scientific research. You will find it attached along with your regular dividends.

descriptions.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，公司运营的很好，我们的收入一直在稳定的增加。以上是本次分红，此外我们还运来了一批额外的资源，这是我们从一个违约的民用客户手中扣押得到的。
descriptions.en: Esteemed Patron, the company is doing well, and our earnings are steadily increasing. Here are your dividends, along with an extra delivery of resources we recovered from a civilian client who defaulted on their payment.

descriptions.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们很高兴在这个财报周期宣告自己的利润突破了记录！鉴于此，我们很乐意在常规分红中加入一笔额外的丰厚提成。
descriptions.en: Esteemed Patron, we are pleased to announce record profits during this fiscal interval! As such, we have included a generous bonus to your regular dividends.

descriptions.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们最近的维和行动成功捣毁了几个海盗组织，我们收缴了一批数量极其丰厚的资源和科技数据。同你的常规分红一起，我们将这批战利品的大部分交付给你。
descriptions.en: Esteemed Patron, our latest peacekeeping operation had us dismantle several pirate operations and we recovered an extraordinary amount of resources and technological data. Most of these have been set apart for you, in addition to your well-earned dividends.

descriptions.zh:
环绕着§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!的探测卫星为我们的载人登陆这颗“虚境星球”的任务识别出了一个可行的目的地。着陆区散发出一种奇怪的辐射，携带着紫外线风暴在整个星球上荡漾。

有很多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]反对这项任务，害怕这种同样的诅咒会释放到我们的母星上。他们的担忧并非没有道理，但理解这种遥远现象的重大必要性压过其他的所有需求。

如果我们注定有一天要遭受同等劫难，至少也死得明明白白。
descriptions.en:
Exploratory satellites orbiting §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! have identified a promising target for our first crewed mission to the surface of this 'Shrouded World.' The landing zone emanates a strange radiation that ripples across the planet, carried forth on ultraviolet winds.

There are many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who protest against this mission in fear of unleashing the same curse upon our homeworld. Their concerns are not without justification, but the overriding need to understand this distant phenomenon must take precedence.

If we are fated to one day suffer this same calamity, at least we will die knowing why.

label.en: The search for answers begins now.

descriptions.zh:
§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!的地貌正如预料般险象环生。暮色粒子形成的漩涡在空中肆虐，拖慢了§H[Leader.GetName]§!及其[Leader.GetHisHer]的组员的初步探索进度。

令人警觉的是，我们的研究小组开始报告感官异常现象——他们描述风中传来遥远的嚎叫，雾霭中潜行着阴影般的轮廓。选择登陆此地是否真是错误？

着陆画面的首次公开在§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!引发了大规模恐慌。许多人担心我们可能会招致那股曾造访[shrouded_planet.GetName]的神秘破坏力量。“终末将临”的抗议势力正在组织起来，抗议活动席卷我们的母星，导致大量基础设施停摆。

遥测扫描显示，附近山脉深处存在一个释放极高辐射水平的空洞。我们决心不惜一切代价继续推进。
descriptions.en:
The terrain on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! is as treacherous as predicted. Swirling vortices of gloaming particles carve through the air, slowing the initial progress of §H[Leader.GetName]§! and [Leader.GetHisHer] crew.

Alarmingly, our research team has begun to report sensory inconsistencies; they describe distant howls carrying on the winds and shadowed figures stalking in the mists. Is it truly a mistake to be here?

The first public broadcasts of the landing have triggered widespread panic on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Many are fearful that we may be courting the mysterious destructive powers that once visited [shrouded_planet.GetName]. Organized protests proclaiming that 'The End is Nigh' are sweeping across our homeworld, shutting down much of our infrastructure.

Telemetric scans have revealed a cavity emanating particularly high radiation levels deep within a nearby mountain range. We are determined to push farther, whatever the cost.

label.zh: 突破表层。我们必须找到等待着我们的东西。
label.en: Breach the surface. We must find what awaits us.

descriptions.zh:
我们并非第一批访客。

突破了§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上山脉中的空洞后，一座在灾难中被遗弃的外星建筑赫然出现。我们认为最好将此信息列为机密，以防止进一步的恐慌。

初步分析证实，该设施建造所使用的材料与星球上现有矿物的分子构成不符，这表明一个星际文明使用了奇异材料建造了这座设施。这个地方的确切用途仍然不明，但其功能似乎已基本自动化。

与此同时，队员们的心理症状正在恶化。有人报告说听到通过加密频率传来的耳语声，另一些人则描述他们对周围物理环境的感知扭曲。偶尔发作的阵阵笑声令人感到不安。

我们已经走得太远，现在无法回头了。
descriptions.en:
We are not the first.

The mountainous cavity on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been breached, revealing an abandoned alien structure lost to the cataclysm. We find it best to keep this information classified in order to prevent further panic.

Preliminary analysis confirms that materials used in the facility's construction do not match the molecular composition of available minerals on the planet, suggesting that a spacefaring civilization built this installation using exotic materials. The exact purpose of this place remains unclear, but its functionality appears to have been mostly automated.

Meanwhile, the team's psychological symptoms are worsening. Some report voices whispering through encrypted frequencies, while others describe distorted perceptions of their surrounding physical environment. Occasional fits of laughter are becoming uncomfortably commonplace.

We have gone too far to turn back now.

descriptions.zh:
他们都死了。

在这座设施核心的每个工作站座椅上，都蜷缩着某种未知外星种族的干瘪尸体，他们苍白的复眼齐刷刷凝视着天花板。尽管形貌可怖，§H[Leader.GetName]§!能基本确定这些生物并非幻觉产物。目前这些生命体的影像资料被列为绝密信息。

现场未发现任何使用武器的痕迹，表明§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上的存在并无敌意。该设施很可能是个观测站，其精密监测设备曾直接对准§H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!。碳同位素测定显示，其活动时间远早于大灾变降临之前。

我们已破译大量记录：除常规通讯日志外，主要内容均与我们一族文明的早期历史相关。
descriptions.en:
They are all dead.

At the seat of each station in the heart of this facility slumps the desiccated corpses of an unknown alien race, their many pale eyes staring toward the ceiling. Despite their frightening appearance, §H[Leader.GetName]§! is reasonably certain these figures are not a product of hallucinations. Images of these life forms are currently classified as strictly confidential.

No weapons of any form can be found, suggesting that their presence on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! lacked hostile intent. This facility was likely an observation post, with sophisticated monitoring equipment trained directly on §H[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]§!. Radiocarbon dating places their activity here long before the cataclysm struck.

We have decoded many of their records; aside from routine communication logs, they largely concern our civilization's early history.

descriptions.zh:
§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上的数据库已被破译，那些曾被我们视为无稽之谈的传说竟被证实为真。我们曾是一项名为“灵能理论”的精神科学实验的对象。

我们一族被认定具有这种天赋的潜势。许多先祖或许曾在梦境中感知到这种形式的连结，或将其误认为遥远的声音——这类现象通常会被归为精神疾病或妄想症。但他们的实验戛然而止；在最后的日子里，此地已非观测站，而是避难所。

他们关于我们社会的报告在发生了一场灾难性实验之后戛然而止——那场在其母星进行的实验鲁莽地操纵了被称为§H“虚境”§!的次元屏障。其科学家将此事变称为“大清算”，我们怀疑这一切正是大灾变的真正源头。

无论这场事变本质为何，其影响很快蔓延至§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!。他们最后的时刻被记录在一条简短的日志中：

§L终焉已至。§!
descriptions.en:
The database on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§! has been deciphered, proving many of our discredited legends to be true. We were the subject of an experiment in the mental science known as 'Psionic Theory'.

Our species was determined to have this latent potential. Many of our ancestors would have sensed these communications in dreams or as distant voices, phenomena that might otherwise indicate mental illness or paranoia. However, their experiment was cut short; in its last days, this place was no observation post, but a survival shelter.

Their reports on our society cease after a disastrous experiment on their capital world involving the reckless manipulation of the barrier between realities known as §H'the Shroud'§!. Their scientists referred to this incident as 'The Reckoning', and we suspect this was the true source of the cataclysm.

Whatever this incident was, its influence soon extended to §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!. Their last moments are recorded in a single log entry:

§LThe End has come.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们已找到引发这场灾变的确凿证据。其踪迹并不难寻；§H[Leader.GetName]§!声称能感知到它在召唤着[Leader.GetHimHer]。

在这座设施深处，存在着超越常规认知的脉动虚体。这个既非物质亦非能量的存在，§H[Leader.GetName]§!将其描述为，被吞噬意志聚集而成的怨念残响，并称之为§H“最终清算之残躯”§!。

该物体原本旨在收集并导引来自§H虚境§!的灵界能量，作为对抗“大清算”的防御手段。但这项计划仅取得部分成功。在这个星球迎来终末的最后时刻，这个饱含恶意的存在被强行驱逐出本维度，同时裹挟走了研究人员们不甘的意志。如今唯余这片残骸。

这个物体会强化研究人员的幻觉与灵视，赋予他们超越现实局限的第二视觉。这既是危险的诱惑，却也蕴含着无限可能。
descriptions.en:
We have found definitive evidence of the cataclysm's source. It was not difficult to find; §H[Leader.GetName]§! claims it called out to [Leader.GetHimHer].

Deep within the facility, defying conventional analysis, a pulsing intangible mass has been identified. Existing neither as matter nor energy, §H[Leader.GetName]§! has described it as the lingering resentment of consumed wills, referring to it as a §H'Fragment of Reckoning'§!.

In a misguided effort to contain and channel the ethereal energies of the §HShroud§!, this object was intended to be used as defense against the Reckoning. However, it was only partially successful. In the last moments of this world, the malevolent entity was forcibly banished from this dimension, taking the unwilling minds of the scientists with it. This fragment is now all that remains.

This object amplifies the visions and hallucinations of our researchers, granting them a second sight beyond this limited reality. It is a dangerous but promising proposition.

label.zh: 我们还有许多要学习的……
label.en: We still have much to learn...

descriptions.zh:
灵能领域的最近研究进展证实，现实存在迄今不可见的维度，而我们的意识正是通往这些维度的门户。在这层帷幕之外，是一片我们难以理解的混沌领域。

从领域的最深处，一个§R心声§!在召唤。它许诺的不是救赎，而是一个新的开端。若要驾驭其不可知的力量，就必须抛弃我们原有的全部存在，在疯狂本身编织的命理中锻造新的命运。

§R“时机已至。”§!
descriptions.en:
Research into the recently discovered field of Psionics has confirmed the existence of hitherto unseen dimensions of reality, to which our minds are the gateway. Beyond this veil lies a realm of chaos we struggle to understand.

From within the depths, a §RVoice§! beckons. Its promise is not of salvation, but of a new beginning. To wield its unknowable power would be to abandon all we were, and to forge a fate inscribed in the fabric of madness itself.

§R"IT IS TIME."§!

descriptions.zh:
我们被召唤去往更高的存在层次。为了维护我们飞升的神圣性，顽固进行徒劳抵抗的人正在被逐步清除。我们的命运已注定；而我们身后的路已坍塌进虚境星球之影中。

§R心声§!以令人信服之清晰向我们开口。

§R“大道已定。”§!

祂渴望着自愿的献祭。
descriptions.en:
We have been called to higher levels of existence. Those among us who clung to fruitless resistance are being purged to preserve the sanctity of our ascension. Our fate is sealed; the way behind us has crumbled into the shadow of the Shrouded World.

The §RVoice§! speaks to us now with compelling clarity.

§R"THE PATH IS SET."§!

It longs for willing sacrifice.

descriptions.zh:
§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!为我们指明了方向。我们的外部感官会掩盖掉这种§R心声§!的呼唤。去掉一种感官，我们就能让心灵的力量进一步提升。

就此而言，放弃我们的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]是最有效的。在物质界的视觉会阻碍我们的§H虚境§!视野。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经以§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!为模范，毫不犹豫地去掉了自己的[Species.GetEyeNamePlural]。

选择如此的人汇报称，那种§R心声§!赞许地充盈着他们的脑海，他们会随之感到一阵满足。
descriptions.en:
§H[blinded_leader.GetName]§! has shown us the way. Our extraneous senses muffle the call of the §RVoice§!. By removing one, we can elevate our psychic abilities even further.

Relinquishing our [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] is the most effective in this regard. Our vision in the physical realm obscures our view into the §HShroud§!. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have already followed §H[blinded_leader.GetName]§!'s inspiring example, removing their [Species.GetEyeNamePlural] without hesitation.

Those who elect to do so report a surge of contentment as the §RVoice§! fills their mind with its approval.

descriptions.zh:
§H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§!对肉体凡胎的限制感到沮丧，试着通过戏剧化地公开服下致命毒素加速[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的灵能转变。

[forsaken_leader.GetHeShe]一死去，[forsaken_leader.GetHisHer]的尸体就被一种鲜艳的紫色所吞噬，分解成纯灵能的细尘。这样的神迹正是通过§R心声§!的意志实现的。

我们认为这是一个很明显的信号；§H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§!去到哪里，所有人必然跟随。
descriptions.en:
Frustrated by the limitations of our flesh, §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! has sought to accelerate [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] psionic transformation by imbibing a lethal toxin in dramatic public display.

As [forsaken_leader.GetHeShe] expired, [forsaken_leader.GetHisHer] body was consumed by a vivid purple hue and disintegrated into a fine dust of pure psionic energy. Such miracles become possible through the will of the §RVoice§!.

We have taken this as a clear sign; where §H[forsaken_leader.GetName]§! led, others must follow.

label.zh: 不能让我们的身体拖了后退。
label.en: Our physical form cannot hold us back.

descriptions.zh:
有些[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]难以与§R心声§!和谐共生。

这些最弱者们绝望地乞求平静，最终采取了粗暴而违规的前额叶切除手术。如果不采取行动，这种做法可能会变得普遍。
descriptions.en:
Some [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are struggling to live in harmony with the presence of the §RVoice§!.

Desperate for peace, the weakest among us have resorted to crude and unregulated lobotomy procedures. Such practices threaten to become widespread if no action is taken.

label.zh: 这些弱者就随他们便吧。
label.en: Let the weak do what they must.

add_situation_progress = -50

label.zh: §R心声§!是份恩赐。禁止这种行为。
label.en: The §RVoice§! is a gift. Ban this practice.

descriptions.zh:
我们继续拥抱§R心声§!。祂开始阐述一些简单而无可拒绝的真理。

许多[owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始找寻更多能增强§R心声§!以便更直地受到这种智慧佑助的方法。

黑市药物的使用量飙升。不受监管的医疗设施开始提供实验性服务，帮助个体最大化灵能敏感度。

这究竟会带来什么后果？
descriptions.en:
We continue to embrace the §RVoice§!. It speaks plain truths to us that cannot be denied.

Many [owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are seeking further ways to amplify the §RVoice§! and benefit from its wisdom more directly.

The use of black-market drugs has increased dramatically. Unregulated medical facilities are offering experimental services to help individuals maximize their psionic sensitivity.

Where will this lead us?

label.zh: 不惜一切代价带来§R心声§!。
label.en: Do all we can to bring forth the §RVoice§!.

label.zh: 必须警惕全面无政府状态。

descriptions.zh:
随着我们的灵能力量与日俱增，[owner.GetSpeciesAdj]人口开始受到预兆着宇宙终结的恐怖梦魇的困扰。

我们的梦已经称为末世预言，加剧了人们的存在主义恐惧。睡眠已被不安的麻木所取代，许多人无法继续正常的日常生活。

在这些梦中，§R心声§!对我们说。

§R“接纳熵吧。”§!
descriptions.en:
As our psionic abilities have grown, the [owner.GetSpeciesAdj] population has become plagued by horrifying nightmares foreshadowing the end of the universe.

Our dreams have become apocalyptic prophecies, intensifying the existential dread felt among our people. Sleep has given way to unquiet stupor, with many unable to carry on their normal daily routines.

In these dreams, the §RVoice§! speaks to us.

§R"EMBRACE ENTROPY."§!

label.en: All beginnings must have an end.
Offer shelter in the Chamber of Silence.

descriptions.zh:
民众中自残的趋势日益增长。

§R心声§!的极端虔诚者在的肉体上烙上了“终末”的标志。他们宣称这种图案会赐予承载者可怖的恩赐。

无论真假，进行这种仪式的人数正在迅速增加。这真的是§H虚境§!的旨意吗？
descriptions.en:
There is a growing trend of self-mutilation among the populace.

Extremely devout followers of the §RVoice§! have been branding their flesh with the symbol of 'The End'. They proclaim that these designs bestow a terrible blessing upon those who bear them.

Whether true or not, the number of practitioners engaged in such rituals is increasing rapidly. Is this truly the will of the §HShroud§!?

label.zh: 我们自豪地背负起这个刻印。
label.en: We bear this mark with pride.

tooltips.zh: 我国一半人口获得['trait:trait_marked']特质。
tooltips.en: Half of our population gain the ['trait:trait_marked'] trait.

descriptions.zh:
我们降入虚境，联合的意志压制住了混沌噪声，使我们专注于目标。§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。

但单凭目标可保护不了我们。无数心声低语着空洞的陈词滥调，意图让我们沉浸在一个比一个更没有意义，但都无比诱人的分神之事中。

我们的心神即将被撕裂时，那个实体回来了，丢下一道命令在虚空中回荡：

§R“闭嘴”。§!
descriptions.en:
We descend into the Shroud, our unified will helping to silence the chaotic noise that would distract us from our goal, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

But purpose alone cannot shield us. Voices whisper empty platitudes, indulging us with paltry distractions, each more meaningless than the last, but all equally tempting.

As we begin to fracture, the entity returns. A single command reverberates through the void:

§R"SILENCE."§!

descriptions.zh:
这道命令劈开了混沌，扫清不和谐的噪音，荡平了那些试图吞噬我们的恼人混乱。我们在忍受着碎裂，而精神维系了下来。

§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!退回了虚境深处。随之而来的清晰几乎同样震耳欲聋。它填补了内心的空白，留给我们了一份新的决心。

以及礼物。如此美妙的礼物。
descriptions.en:
This command cleaves through the chaos, scouring the discordant noise, purging the obtrusive disorder that sought to consume us. Our psyche holds as we endure the fragmentation.

The §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! recedes further into the Shroud. The clarity that follows is almost as deafening. It settles into gaps in our minds, leaving us with newfound resolve.

And gifts. Such wonderful gifts.

descriptions.zh:
当我们潜入虚境时，看到了感性的混沌正在腐败。

溃烂而懒惰的心灵产生了层层的灵能乱流，用腐臭污染着虚境。在这令人厌恶的混沌中，我们感受一种压倒一切的存在，§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!。

随着祂逼近混沌，那种邪恶的意图饱和了我们的心灵。一道命令回响到虚空中，我们也为即将到来的赦免做好了准备：

§R“秩序。团结。”§!
descriptions.en:
As we delve into the Shroud, we observe a corruption of sentient chaos.

Festering, idle minds generate layers of psionic turbulence, polluting the Shroud with fetid rot. Within this odious mess, we begin to feel the overwhelming presence of our quarry, the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!.

The malice of its intentions saturates our psyche as it bears down upon the chaos. We brace for the impending absolution as a command resonates throughout the void:

§R"ORDER. UNITY."§!

descriptions.zh:
这道命令流过恶毒的混沌。

§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!洗去那些正在荼毒虚境的感性的扭曲时，无数声音痛苦地呼喊起来来。在祂的身后留下了一片被赦免的不完美之境地。

这个实体潜回虚境的深处，只留下祂绝对净化的余波让我们观察研究。
descriptions.en:
The command courses through the malignant chaos.

Innumerable voices cry out in pain as the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! washes away the sentient deformations plaguing the Shroud. A realm of absolved imperfections remains in its wake.

As the entity submerges itself deeper within the Shroud, we are left to observe and study the aftermath of its absolute purification.

descriptions.zh:
步入虚境，我们只余痛楚。翻腾的灵能迷雾化作炼狱，灼烧着我们心智的本质。

在煎熬中，我们目睹城市崩塌为熔融的废墟，行星被烈焰吞噬，无数生灵在幽火中扭曲挣扎，血肉之躯化为闷燃的灰烬。

在这焚毁万象的烈焰中心，我们感知到§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的存在。当它的力量即将吞噬现实时，此实体降下谕令：

§R“解禁。”§!
descriptions.en:
Entering the Shroud, we know only pain. The usual swirling psionic mists are an inferno, igniting the very essence of our minds.

Through the torment, we perceive cities crumbling into molten ruin, planets devoured by fire, entire populations writhing in agony as spectral flames reduce their corporeal forms to smouldering ash.

At the centre of the pyre, we detect the presence of the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!. As its power threatens to consume reality, the entity decrees:

§R"LIBERATION."§!

descriptions.zh:
灵能之火吞噬我们的思想，焚尽一切自满。只留下纯粹的决心。

如今我们得以窥见§R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§!的崇高使命，以及它所展现的壮丽简约。
descriptions.en:
The psionic flames engulf our minds, burning away complacency. Leaving only a purified resolve.

Now we can see the glorious purpose of the §R[Root.Patron:end_of_the_cycle.GetPreCommunicationName]§! and the magnificent simplicity it offers.

descriptions.zh:
一声宣告响彻寰宇：

§R“尔等皆知吾名。”§!

我们星际航行的终极目标，数个世纪疑问的答案，此刻揭晓。§R轮回之终末§!正召唤着我们。盟约已成。

§R“万物终焉始于斯。”§!

痛苦。扭曲。确信。当余音消散，命运已成定局。

此刻我们终得窥见。星系归于寂灭，浸没在§R终末光环§!无可违逆的宿命之中。
descriptions.en:
A declaration rings out:

§R"YOU KNOW MY NAME."§!

The culmination of our voyage to the stars, the answer to centuries of questions, is here. The §REnd of the Cycle§! compels us. Our Covenant is formed.

§R"THE END BEGINS."§!

Pain. Writhing. Certainty. As the words fade, our fate is sealed.

We see it now. A galaxy rendered silent, saturated in the inevitability of the §RAura of the End§!.

descriptions.zh:
动用§R轮回之终末§!的力量需付出代价，而我们的时间所剩无几。

星海仍未浸润在我方超主净化的辉光之中。迄今为止的努力不过沧海一粟。

为见证这项伟业完成，一股新生能量正自帷幕之外奔涌而来。此乃应许之赐福！
descriptions.en:
The power of the §REnd of the Cycle§! comes at a cost, and we are running out of time.

The galaxy remains unsaturated by our patron's cleansing Aura. Our efforts thus far amount to insignificance.

To see this monumental work completed, a surge of energy flows newly into us from beyond the veil. It is a promised blessing!

我们超主的力量浩瀚无垠，但时间已所剩无几。此等渎职之举，断不为§R轮回之终末§!的仁慈湮灭所容。

尚存一线希望：我们必须不惜代价让终末光环吞噬整个星系。危亡之际，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正从§H虚境§!中榨取每一分能量。
descriptions.en:
The power of our patron is immense, but we are nearly out of time. Such flagrant incompetence will not be tolerated by the benevolent oblivion of the §REnd of the Cycle§!.

A slim hope remains: We must engulf the galaxy in the Aura of the End, no matter the cost. In desperation, our [GetTelepathPlural] now draw every ounce of energy they can from within the §HShroud§!.

星海参议院已废止将毁灭性§H灵能光环§!发散器指定为防御重点的议案。因此，所有由星海共同体成员国针对§H[former_malevolent_aura.GetName]§!展开的军事行动都被立即叫停。现在，和平已经降临至星系的这一隅。

如果我们还想继续打下去，没什么能够阻止我们对这些蠢蛋分别宣战，然后一个接一个地干翻他们……

For now, peace has returned to this corner of the galaxy.

If we want to continue fighting, there is nothing stopping us from declaring war on the fools individually, taking them out one by one...

descriptions.zh:
我们超主无可违逆的意志正将星海逐渐攥入掌心。此刻，我们已然知晓终焉降临的方式。

必须将§R终末光环§!播撒至星系的每个角落。当物质界与这§H虚境§!的原始本质相融之时，真正的湮灭便将接踵而至。

消灭这个星系中的所有生命将是一个令人欣慰的附带效果。完成这项宏伟任务将成为我们的巅峰之作，也是通往终极救赎之门。
descriptions.en:
Our patron's inevitable will tightens its grip over the galaxy. We know now how the End will come.

The §RAura of the End§! must be spread throughout the galaxy. Once the physical realm combines with this raw essence of the §HShroud§!, true annihilation will shortly follow.

The eradication of all life in this galaxy will be a welcome side effect. Completing this monumental task will be our magnum opus and the gateway to ultimate salvation.

descriptions.zh:
这是我们的命运。

§R终末光环§!吞噬了整个星系。我们[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的人民正沉浸在狂热的喜悦之中，以庆祝这一时刻。旨在消灭所有非我族类。完成这项宏伟任务将成为我们的巅峰之作，也是通往终极救赎之门。
descriptions.en:
This was our destiny.

The §RAura of the End§! envelopes the galaxy. Our people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have entered a state of frenzied euphoria in celebration of the obliteration of all that is not us. Completing this monumental task will be our magnum opus and the gateway to ultimate salvation.

descriptions.zh:
这是我们的命运。

§R终末光环§!吞噬了整个星系。我们[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的人民正沉浸在狂热的喜悦之中，以庆祝这一时刻。我们仁慈的救赎。一场辉煌的重生即将降临，这是我们自大觉醒时代便蒙受的应许。

眼前，万有皆被虚空吞噬。抹除与湮灭，已成为星海仅存的法则。世界接连崩塌，复归最初孕育它们的虚无。

我们终将步入终局。这景象……何其壮美。我们已窥见它在新生的脆弱形态中挣扎。终焉已至，此刻即是开端。
descriptions.en:
This was our destiny.

The §RAura of the End§! envelopes the galaxy. Our people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] have entered a state of frenzied euphoria in celebration of our merciful salvation. A glorious rebirth is upon us, promised from the time of our great awakening.

Before us, all of existence is consumed by the void. Erasure and annihilation have become the galaxy's only remaining laws. One by one, entire worlds collapse into the nothingness from which they once came.

We are the last to be taken. It is... beautiful. We see it already in its throes of a new, fragile form. The End has come. Now starts the Beginning.

tooltips.zh:
我们终结了轮回。

§Y星系毁灭了。§!
tooltips.en:
We ended the cycle.

§YThe galaxy is destroyed.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们失败了。由于我们的软弱，§R轮回之终末§!未能如期实现其辉煌的成果。现在，我们必须为自己的无能付出代价。

Most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] embraced this destiny, but a small group of the unfaithful refused to submit to the ultimate will of our patron. They are the exiles led by §H[Root.GetRulerName]§!, a powerful psychic who knew what was to come; they have gone into hiding on a world outside the influence of the End.

Made immensely powerful by the devoured consciousnesses of our psionics, it now roams the galaxy seeking to finish the task we could not complete. When it is done, it will come for the exiled as well.

descriptions.zh:
大功告成。§R清算§!已被摧毁。

§R轮回之终末§!已撤退回§H虚境§!深处。它对我们物理现实构成的威胁暂时已被遏制。

当其化身的虚境残躯螺旋式地脱离此存在时，我们成功回收了其显现的物理残余物。即使在死亡中，我们的心灵感应者也能感觉到它散发出惊人的灵能，远比在§H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!上回收的碎片强大。

这枚浓缩了必然性的核心可用于从幸存于此次清算的星系灰烬中重建。

末日已然降临又离去，但不知为何，我们依然存在。
descriptions.en:
It is done. The §RReckoning§! has been destroyed.

The §REnd of the Cycle§! has retreated back into the depths of the §HShroud§!. The threat it posed to our physical reality has been forestalled for now.

As the shrouded corpse of its avatar spiraled out of this existence, a physical remnant of its manifestation was successfully recovered. Even in death, our telepaths can feel it emitting staggering levels of psionic energy, vastly more powerful than the fragment recovered on §H[shrouded_planet.GetName]§!.

This core of concentrated inevitability can be used to rebuild from the ashes of the galaxy that survived this Reckoning.

The End has come and gone, yet somehow we remain.
